name: Motorcycle Simulator Arkansas
summary:
Ride Little Rock, Arkansas, from the seat - alone or with your friends.

36 KM ROUND LITTLE ROCK
West on I-630 through Midtown past War Memorial Stadium, north on I-430 high over the Arkansas River, east on I-40 through North Little Rock, then south on I-30 across the river into downtown with the State Capitol and Simmons Tower ahead.

RIDE IT LIKE A REAL BIKE
